// note: Browser code. Tests are a separate project (tsconfig.test.json) because they read the ABI off disk and so need node types, which browser code must not have.
// noUncheckedIndexedAccess: Off for THIS project only, and only because of src/pages/landing, as in mero-chess.
That page is generated from the fleet-wide template by `pnpm landing:generate`,
which has never been compiled under this flag. Editing the generated copy is
not an option: `pnpm landing:check` fails CI the moment it drifts.
The code this app owns keeps the check: tsconfig.test.json compiles all of src
except the generated landing, with the flag inherited from tsconfig.base.json.
